senses.gloss:
अधेनु अ-धेनु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. yielding no
milk or advantage; not nourishing.

आ-धेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be deposited or placed;
to be pledged or mortgaged; what is put down or has
a place assigned to it; to be assigned, attributed or
given; to be received, held or supported; (अम्), n.
= आ-धान, q. v.

आधेनव आधेनव, अम्, n. (fr. अ-धेनु),
want of cows.
